A whitespace-only span opening a div does not indent the image after it into a code block

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>P</p>\n<div>\n<span>    </span><img alt=\"A\" src=\"S\"/>\n</div>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
